name: FLUX.2 Klein Image
description: Text-to-image with FLUX.2 Klein 4B. High-fidelity stills from a prompt, with two optional LoRA slots.

prompt.description: Natural language sentences, not tags — the opposite of an SDXL prompt. Subject, then action, then style, then context, in that order: word order is weight, so lead with the subject and close with atmosphere. 30-80 words suits most shots. 'A businessman in a charcoal grey suit resting his arms on a bamboo railing at a secluded beach, illustrated in a vintage woodblock print style, calm turquoise water under a hazy afternoon sky.' FLUX.2 has no negative prompt and this graph has no node for one, so describe what you want instead of what you don't — 'sharp focus throughout', not 'not blurry'. For photorealism, name a camera, lens or film stock rather than saying 'professional'.

lora_name.description: Optional LoRA file in the node's loras folder. Leave empty and the slot is removed from the graph entirely. A FLUX.2 LoRA is built for one variant: a Klein 4B LoRA does not load on Klein 9B or on FLUX.2-dev, and a dev LoRA does not load here — the residual stream is 3072 wide on 4B against 6144 on dev, so the tensors do not fit. Match the LoRA's stated base model to the weights in the unet param.

lora_strength.description: Weight of the first LoRA. Ignored when lora_name is empty.

lora_name_2.description: Second LoRA, chained after the first — for stacking a concept LoRA on top of a likeness or style one. Same variant rule as lora_name.

lora_strength_2.description: Weight of the second LoRA. Ignored when lora_name_2 is empty.

steps.description: Klein is distilled to 4 steps; raise it only when running undistilled FLUX.2 weights through the unet param

examples.prompt: A weathered fishing boat moored at a stone quay before dawn, ropes coiled on the deck, shot on Kodak Portra 400 at 35mm f/2, soft blue pre-sunrise light and still water holding the reflection.
